legend-rota-romantica-brazil.slogan: Rota Romantica Brazil – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-rota-romantica-brazil.story: official tourism route. forest, European-influenced towns, rolling hills. A one-way ride of 104 km, Porto Alegre to Canela - roughly 1 h 53 in the saddle. It goes by way of Novo Hamburgo and Nova Petrópolis. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Rota Romantica Brazil
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 23 km this is Rota Romantica Brazil, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
